lines.x: Russian energy company Lukoil is preparing its Petrotel oil refinery in Ploiesti, Romania, to resume fuel production activities following operational suspensions.
Romania and Turkey have held seven national security council meetings in six months over the Russia-Ukraine war, airspace violations and threats to commercial shipping.
Romanian Finance Minister Alexandru Nazare confirmed the country aims for a 2027 budget deficit near 5% of GDP while cutting non-essential state investments.
UniCredit Romania is coordinating an €850 million syndicated loan to support Premier Energy’s acquisition of the Evryo Group.
